name: update_thesis
description: Archive a thesis the user no longer holds (is_active false), or restore an archived one (is_active true). Only call this when the user asks. Find the ID with postgres_database_query on theses; if several theses plausibly match, ask which one. While archived, a thesis is not assessed against new claims, sends no email alerts or digest sections, and is hidden from the knowledge graph view; its existing assessments are kept. Its email alert subscriptions are kept too and resume if it is restored; if the user wants them gone, turn them off with update_notification. Archiving is how a thesis is removed. To change a thesis's wording, archive it and save the new version with add_thesis. Confirm to the user what was archived or restored.

is_active.description: false to archive the thesis, true to restore it.
